newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BTR's Philip Aiken joins BHP.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BTR's Philip Aiken joins BHP.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Thursday it had appointed Philip Aiken as executive general manager, corporate development, effective May 1.
Aiken is currently managing director of BTR Plc's BTR Nylex unit and an executive director of BTR Plc.
He replaces Jim Lewis, who was recently appointed executive general manager and president BHP Copper.

BHP said Aiken would play a leading role in the office of the managing director with responsibility for strategic planning for the company as a whole and business development in areas outside existing core businesses.
BHP managing director and chief executive officer John Prescott said in a statement Aiken's broad management and internatonal experience would bring new perspectives to BHP's senior management team.
